entities.summary: Ricardo Preston Ratliffe, later known as Ra Gun-ah, is an American-born South Korean professional basketball player for the Daegu KOGAS Pegasus of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). He played collegiately at the University of Missouri and was naturalized in January 2018.
